provenance.data: real BraTS via MSD Task01, enhancing tumor, et_full.npz
provenance.split: val (70 cases, 2650 slices, 9490 lesions). test left sealed.
provenance.segmenter: shared frozen segmenter unless stated otherwise

safety_layer_trigger.method: segment acquired scan and enhanced image; flag regions present in the first and absent in the second
safety_layer_trigger.coverage_note: only lesions the reader saw in the acquired scan are flaggable

mc_dropout.note: AUROC below 0.5 means the sign is inverted: erasure comes with LOWER uncertainty

conformal_logodds_monitor.note: guarantee met only by flagging almost everything

segmenter_domain_gap.note: train_segmenter trains on clean HR only; it is then used to score LR and SR
segmenter_domain_gap.implication: 22% of measured erasure was the reader's domain gap, not damage from super-resolution
